versions.notes: «Mask» as a quick switch in the camera control (web and window): shows the motion mask over the picture.

«Talk» as a quick switch in the camera control - safe against an accidental press: tap once to unlock (6 s; a long press does not unlock), then hold to talk. It replaces the unprotected big button next to the joystick.
own GPS module (USB / serial, or gpsd): location without the phone; theft tracking - when the armed device is carried away, an alarm and then its position (map link) every 5 minutes.
storm warning (Sensors): push message when the air pressure falls fast (BME280), when a wind meter (anemometer on a GPIO) measures strong wind, or (optional) when the forecast expects gusts.

extra sensors (new group «Sensors»): motion detector (PIR), door / lid contact and gas / smoke module on a GPIO, 433 MHz radio sensors (RTL-SDR stick + rtl_433), Zigbee sensors (Zigbee2MQTT over MQTT) and Bluetooth tags (RuuviTag: moved / out of range). Alarm when armed or always (gas); a PIR wakes the power saving mode.
every settings topic has its own symbol (web and window); the camera picture can be turned (90° / 180° / 270°) and mirrored - for a camera mounted sideways or upside down.
thermal camera settings in three parts (alarm / picture / camera & alignment); a button left of the settings search hides the whole settings column (a tab at the right edge brings it back).
the settings search with its three buttons stays at the top while scrolling.
message texts: every message (person, pre-alarm, thermal, noise) folds open and closed.
settings: a third button «open the groups only» (all groups open, their topics closed = overview).

System: bars for memory (RAM) and storage; the buttons are in small fold-out groups. Message texts: one card per message with bigger fields, tap to insert a placeholder, «standard text» and a preview.

picture for other programs (Home Assistant, Frigate, Blue Iris, VLC, NAS recorders): a secret address for the video (MJPEG) and a still picture, no login needed; optionally RTSP (H.264) if mediamtx is installed.

continuous recording (off by default): all the time with few pictures per second in 10-minute pieces, kept for N hours; the recordings page shows a 24-hour timeline with the alarms marked - tap to watch.

storage: the self-check shows where the program and the recordings are (SD card / SSD / USB); the recordings can be put on an SSD or USB drive (Settings -> Recording, existing ones are moved over); if the drive is missing at a start, the memory card is used and the self-check says so.

zones: «line» (a person crosses it - in both directions or only in the arrow direction) and «dwell area» (a person stays longer than N seconds); message in the log and - when armed - a push message with picture.
backup: the first picture of an alarm goes off the device at once (not only the clip at the end); clips too big for Telegram are made smaller instead of skipped; the self-check shows the backup.
operator mode button shows when it is on (since when) and ends it with the PIN; the header badge too.
«Recalibrate» and «Reset counter» removed from System («↻ Calibrate» stays next to the stick).

operator mode may change everything (also zones, schedules, waypoints, relays) - except what could lock you out: Wi-Fi / own Wi-Fi / network, web password, autostart, loading settings, «reset settings», update source. Unlocking with the PIN puts everything back.

operator mode keeps a copy of all settings when it is switched on; unlocking with the PIN puts back everything that was changed in the meantime (not: armed / disarmed, camera position, location, own Wi-Fi).
